name: qm
description: qm is a multiplayer harness for AI agent work, built to let multiple agents (and humans) collaborate on the same tasks. It treats agent runs as shared, inspectable state rather than isolated one-off sessions, which makes long-running and team-scale agent workflows more manageable. The project comes out of the Y Combinator software team and is positioned as infrastructure for real work, not just demos.
highlights: Multiplayer agent runs that multiple participants can observe and steer
First-party harness from the Y Combinator software team
Treats agent work as shared state, enabling long-running collaborative tasks
12.8k stars within days of release signals strong early traction
curatorNote: YC shipping an internal agent harness publicly is a signal moment — the 'one agent, one terminal' era is giving way to shared, observable agent sessions. qm is the strongest multiplayer take on that shift so far.
